chapters.name: Grammar — Tenses and Voice
chapters.introduction: English grammar in IOE entrance focuses on tenses, active/passive voice, direct/indirect speech, and prepositions. A solid command of grammar rules helps score easy marks in the 10-mark English section.
chapters.whyItMatters: 2-3 marks from grammar. Tenses and voice transformation are nearly guaranteed questions.

topics.name: Tenses
topics.explanation:
English has 12 tenses grouped into four categories: simple, continuous, perfect, and perfect continuous for past, present, and future. For IOE, focus on identifying the correct tense from context and converting between tenses.

Present Simple: I go (habitual actions). Present Continuous: I am going (ongoing). Present Perfect: I have gone (past action with present relevance). These distinctions appear in fill-in-the-blank questions.
topics.examTip: Look for signal words: 'yesterday' = past simple, 'since/for' = present perfect, 'at the moment' = present continuous.
